name: Select
summary: Choose one option from a list. In code a native <select>, so keyboard, mobile and screen readers work out of the box.
use: One choice from 6 or more options.
When space is tight and the options are known (country, month).
avoid: 2 to 5 options: use Radio, so you see everything at once.
anatomy: Trigger: optional leading icon, chosen value or placeholder, chevron.
figmaProps: Placeholder, Filled, Hover, Focus, Error, Disabled
Off by default. Turn it on and swap to an Icon or a Flag/XX for a country choice.
reactProps: First option, you cannot choose it.
Icon or <Flag code={value} /> (from @rbbds/ui/flags). Only shows the chosen country: a native select cannot show images in its options.
behaviour: Opens the browser's own list. The placeholder has a lighter color until there is a value.
a11y: Native <select>: arrow keys and typing to search work out of the box.
Label, hint and error are linked like in Input.
content: Placeholder as an instruction: "Choose a country".
Sort options in a logical way: alphabetical, or the most chosen at the top.
do: Choose a sensible default value if there is one.
dont: A Select with two options like Yes/No.
open: In Figma the open list is not a component yet. In code the browser shows its native list.
